description: This file contains server-side logic for the MCQExam page in an online examination system, including loading questions from a database, handling timer events, and processing exam submissions.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the MCQExam ASP.NET page handling question loading, user interactions, and timer management.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page initialization; loads questions from database based on selected course and manages exam timer.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates user's score based on selected answers, records the result in the database, and navigates to the result page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and redirects to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates countdown timer display and handles timer expiration behavior.
